message.content:
Here is how to log in to OneDrive:

## Web Browser (OneDrive Web Version)

**Step 1:** Go to the OneDrive login portal:
- **https://onedrive.live.com/login/** (personal accounts)
- **https://portal.office.com/onedrive** or **https://m365.cloud.microsoft** (work/school accounts)

**Step 2:** Click the **"Sign in"** button in the top-right corner.

**Step 3:** Enter your **Microsoft account email address** (or phone number) and click **Next**.

**Step 4:** Enter your **password** and click **Sign in**.

**Step 5:** If you have **two-factor authentication (2FA/MFA)** enabled, verify your identity using your chosen method (text code, authenticator app, etc.).

**Step 6:** You will now be logged into your OneDrive web interface where you can upload, download, and manage files.

---

## Windows Desktop App

**Step 1:** Search for **"OneDrive"** in the Windows Start menu or taskbar search box.

**Step 2:** Click on the **OneDrive app** to open it.

**Step 3:** Enter your **Microsoft account email address** when prompted and click **Sign in**.

**Step 4:** Enter your **password** and complete any MFA verification if required.

**Step 5:** Follow the setup prompts to choose your sync folder location.

**Step 6:** Your OneDrive folder will now appear in File Explorer.

---

## Mobile Device (Android/iOS)

**Step 1:** Download and install the **OneDrive app** from your device's app store (Google Play Store or Apple App Store).

**Step 2:** Open the **OneDrive app**.

**Step 3:** Tap **Sign in** and enter your **Microsoft account credentials**.

**Step 4:** Complete any additional verification steps if prompted.

---

## Important Notes

- You need a **Microsoft account** to use OneDrive. If you don't have one, click **"Create one"** or **"No account? Create one!"** on the login page.
- For **work or school accounts**, use your organization-provided email (e.g., username@company.edu).
- If you **forgot your password**, click the **"Forgot password?"** link on the login page to reset it.
- Make sure you're using a **secure network** when logging in, especially on public Wi-Fi.

---

Sources:
1. https://td.usnh.edu/TDClient/60/Portal/KB/Article/2064/OneDrive-Accessing-Logging-in-to-OneDrive
2. https://www.systoolsgroup.com/updates/copy-onedrive-files-to-another-onedrive-account/
3. https://www.bunian.cn/22394.html
4. https://zhidao.baidu.com/question/931669486309366379.html
5. https://www.cu.edu/doc/how-log-onedrive-pcpdf-3
6. https://inclowdz.wondershare.com/cloud-manage/switch-onedrive-account.html
7. https://www.xda-developers.com/how-to-sign-into-onedrive/
